# Draft:Illyrian invasions of Macedonia 393 BC and 360 BC

----
The Illyrian invasions of Macedonia where  2 invasions that happened in the year 393 BC  and 360 BC between the Illyrian king Bardylis and  the Macedonian kings Amyntas III of Macedon and Perdiccas III of Macedon
